verdict.rationale: LaunchDarkly documents a dedicated Cloudflare edge SDK and advertises 4 edge SDKs, which covers flag evaluation in CDN workers. It also documents the Relay Proxy, which runs on your own infrastructure and proxies the streaming connection to clients. Community users independently confirm the Relay can run proxies closer to your services. Missing for 10: the other edge platforms beyond Cloudflare are not named, there is no detail on how edge evaluation works (e.g., data store or latency behavior), and there is no hands-on corroboration of the edge SDKs.

support.subject: As a platform engineer, I can evaluate flags at the edge (CDN workers or an edge/relay layer) close to users

citations.quote: If you are using Cloudflare SDK version 2.3.0 or later, you can use the Cloudflare SDK by itself.
